# PROCESSOR_DATA/testdata

This folder stores sample EDI Excel files used by parser tests.

## Files

| Path | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `testdata_for_edi_lotte.xlsx` | Lotte parser test fixture. |
| `testdata_for_edi_silla.xlsx` | Silla parser test fixture. |

## Boundary Notes

- Test fixtures may be updated when parser contracts change.
- Do not treat these files as production data.
